summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for NCP1117LPST33T3G (onsemi, SOT-223-3, fixed-ldo): evaluated 37 same-category OPNs and shortlisted the top 9 ranked replacements (0 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 5 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 4 Level 3 Layout Change). Verify pinout, thermal margin, lifecycle status, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

candidates.key_advantage: Lower Iq (65 µA vs 550 µA); Higher Vin,max (15 V vs 12 V)
Higher Vin,max (15 V vs 12 V); Ceramic MLCC stable (no tantalum ESR floor)
candidates.key_tradeoff: Higher Iq (4000 µA vs 550 µA); Lower Iout (800 mA vs 1000 mA)
Higher Iq (5000 µA vs 550 µA); Lower Iout (800 mA vs 1000 mA)

candidates.key_tradeoff: Pinout or exposed-pad mismatch requires PCB rerouting; Lower Vin,max (6 V vs 12 V)

selection_checklist: Verify exact pin numbering on SOT-223-3 (1=GND, 2=VOUT, 3=VIN) and exposed pad net (VOUT).
Confirm output capacitor ESR stability (ESR window 0.02–20 Ω (p.2)) and DC-bias derated capacitance >= 10 µF.
Check worst-case junction temperature Tj = Ta + (Vin,max - 3.3 V) × Iout × θJA stays >= 15 °C below Tj,max (150 °C).
Validate input transient headroom against Vin,max (12 V rec / 18 V abs) and Pin 4 (NC vs BYPASS) PCB net connectivity.
